description_en: Create a PDS (formerly Wuying Cloud Disk)
description_zh: 创建企业网盘（原无影云盘）
kebab_example: aliyun ecd create-cloud-drive-service --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --name wuying-cds --office-site-type SIMPLE --office-site-id cn-hangzhou+dir-4006950000 --cen-id cen-g4ba1mkji8nj60000 --domain-name test.local --user-max-size 104857600 --max-size 536870912000 --end-user-id alice --biz-type 1 --solution-id example-string --cds-charge-type PostPaid --auto-pay false --auto-renew false --period 1 --period-unit Year --user-count 5 --reseller-owner-uid 1 --api-version 2020-09-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateCloudDriveService

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196646.html operation to query the regions supported by Elastic Desktop Service
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196646.html获取无影云电脑支持的地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the cloud drive
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The type of the office site
parameters.name: office_site_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the office site. This parameter applies only when `OfficeSiteType` is set to `AD_CONNECTOR`
parameters.help_zh: 办公网络ID，当办公网络类型为`AD_CONNECTOR`时有效
parameters.name: office_site_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN) instance. This parameter is required when `OfficeSiteType` is set to `AD_CONNECTOR` and you do not specify `OfficeSiteId`
parameters.help_zh: 当`OfficeSiteType`为`AD_CONNECTOR`时，表示AD办公网络的云企业网实例ID。当`OfficeSiteId`不为空时，此值可不填写
parameters.name: cen_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the domain controller. This parameter is required when `OfficeSiteType` is set to `AD_CONNECTOR` and you do not specify `OfficeSiteId`
parameters.help_zh: 当`OfficeSiteType`为`AD_CONNECTOR`时，表示AD办公网络对应的域控名称。当`OfficeSiteId`不为空时，此值可不填写
parameters.name: domain_name

parameters.help_en: The maximum size of the personal disk for each user, in bytes
parameters.help_zh: 分配用户个人盘时，个人盘的存储峰值。单位：Byte（字节）
parameters.name: user_max_size

parameters.help_en:
The total capacity of the cloud drive.

For pay-as-you-go cloud drives, the unit is bytes.

For subscription cloud drives, the unit is GiB. For example, set the value to 500 for 500 GiB, or to 2048 for 2 TiB
parameters.help_zh:
网盘存储空间最大峰值。

创建按量付费网盘时，单位为Byte（字节）。
创建预付费网盘时，单位为GiB。例如，如需创建500GiB的预付费网盘，则填写500；如需创建2TiB的预付费网盘，则填写2048
parameters.name: max_size

parameters.help_en: This parameter is not publicly available
parameters.name: biz_type

parameters.help_en: This parameter is not publicly available
parameters.name: solution_id

parameters.help_en: The billing method of the cloud drive
parameters.name: cds_charge_type

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable automatic payment
parameters.name: auto_pay

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable auto-renewal. This parameter applies only when `CdsChargeType` is set to `PrePaid`
parameters.help_zh: 是否自动续费。仅当付费类型为`PrePaid`时，该参数才生效且为可选参数
parameters.name: auto_renew

parameters.help_en: The subscription duration. The unit is specified by `PeriodUnit`. This parameter is required only when `CdsChargeType` is set to `PrePaid`
parameters.help_zh: 购买资源的时长。单位由`PeriodUnit`指定。当参数`CdsChargeType`取值为`PrePaid`时才生效，且为必选值
parameters.name: period

parameters.help_en: The unit of the subscription duration. This parameter is required only when `CdsChargeType` is set to `PrePaid`
parameters.help_zh: 预付费网盘的购买时长单位。当参数`CdsChargeType`取值为`PrePaid`时才生效，且为必选值
parameters.name: period_unit

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of users for a subscription cloud drive. This parameter is required only when `CdsChargeType` is set to `PrePaid`
parameters.help_zh: 预付费网盘的用户数量限额。当参数`CdsChargeType`取值为`PrePaid`时才生效，且为必选值
parameters.name: user_count
